question: Does interruption of the Kṛttikā lamp due to public calamities require expiation?
premises: The Kṛttikā lamp observance may be interrupted
Interruptions may arise from kingdom disturbance and similar causes
Such interruptions break a prescribed observance
inference: Interruption of the Kṛttikā lamp by calamities constitutes a defect needing remedy
plain_english: When the Kṛttikā lamp is interrupted due to causes such as disturbance in the kingdom.
